environment: Single laptop, minikube rank-dev, PostgreSQL/River, S3-compatible SeaweedFS and OpenSandbox with deterministic model fixtures

checks: Gateway protects management, leaves public API bearer authentication to Rank, and hides internal commands
Independent operator identities, live credential revocation, scoped control service and tenant/endpoint public permissions hold through the gateway
Known worker failure retains output, usage and S3 result evidence after cleanup; idempotent replay stays on attempt one
Frozen model budget stops repeated 429 calls after one provider request and survives idempotent replay
Existing daily-news client and two-turn OpenAI SDK chat cross gateway, Rank, PostgreSQL/River, DSH workers and local provider
Structured roles survive durable admission; S3-backed stdout and cursor-based terminal SSE replay remain readable
Direct Agent trial completes through DSH and PostgreSQL history filters return the same conversation
Configured Rank control host runs a separate persistent native conversation
Rank and control Pod replacement retains serving lineage and control history; a fresh invocation continues the conversation
Worker scale-to-zero queues accepted work; Rank restart and scale-up complete the same request once, retaining old S3 evidence

limitations: Operators administer one shared workspace; no team-isolated Agent/Dataset/model-connection ownership
No enterprise SSO, complete audit, internal service-token overlap rotation or production TLS acceptance
Credential revocation applies after file projection and on subsequent authorization; it does not cancel accepted work or open streams
No real provider quota, physical multi-host capacity or high-availability acceptance
